scope: V7 S3TC Still Kingdom Cut cemetery stair, retaining sides and footing in the existing Sereth cemetery placement only
author: Torn Asunder terrain asset author

evidence.godot_context: S3TC exact native production hero foot, crest/back, east/west and sector/overview captures, with 30 measured distance samples.
evidence.close_up: Exact native production close-mortar and 3.05 s gameplay frame.
evidence.reproduction: Godot 4.7.2 GL Compatibility, 1280×720. On the Sereth Cut playtest approach the stairs from the lower path near XZ (-82.72, 66.65), turn to inspect both walls, ascend to the crest, then use Shift/Home and M to inspect tactical sector and full overview. Fixed-camera ABBA toggles only cemetery art and old render mesh visibility, 8 warm and 42 timed renders per block.
evidence.measurements: Production gate and serial ABBA: 3,844,832 compressed texture bytes with mips; 929/461 hero/tactical triangles including footing; +689/+257/+233 displayed primitives and -18/-15/-17 draws; software only.

shape_and_craft.finding: Actual hero approach, stair crest/back, both retaining sides and landing: the prior tread holes are repaired; footing integrates with the lower path and the stair stays legible.

materials_and_lighting.finding: Matched native game lighting and exact V7 S3TC import; prior buried-ramp bands are gone, with crest, flank and mortar close-ups checked under the intended map lighting.

readability_in_play.finding: 30 measured native perspective/orthographic samples, one LOD each time, near below 60 m and tactical at and above 60 m. Actual command samples 79.25 m (sector) and 448.34 m (overview). Footing remains.

integration_and_cost.finding: Clean import, no unrelated scene or collision/marker edits, and five native gameplay/terrain/camera tests. Measured software scene cost remains within the narrow accepted kit budget; no hardware claim.

motion_and_effects.reason: Static environment kit, no animation or effects; native physical hero ascent and camera transitions were independently reviewed as integration evidence.

software_comparison.backend: Godot 4.7.2 GL Compatibility / Mesa llvmpipe, four threads, 1280×720

tests: Actual W/Q/E ascent and Shift/Home/M camera input
